question: Where PM2.5 fell sharply, what changed (policy events)?
summary: The biggest declines since 1990 were in Bolivia (-70%), Estonia (-69%), Lithuania (-66%). Policy events recorded for these countries: EU Emissions Trading System launched (2005); Global financial crisis (2008-09) (2008); Kyoto Protocol enters into force (2005). Matching an event to a decline shows timing overlap, not proof; check each country's PM2.5 curve around the event year.
